lines.text: Many learners say: I near missed the bus.
Better: I nearly missed the bus.
Nearly! We nearly won the game.

publish.title: Say "I nearly missed the bus", not "I near missed the bus"
publish.value: Say "I nearly missed the bus", not "I near missed the bus". Nearly means almost.
